item.title: Image and Shader Generation
item.description: Introducing image generation and generated shaders in Framer. Ask the Agent for a custom image, texture, or illustration that fits your site. You can also drop an image into the chat or select one on the canvas, then ask the Agent to swap the subject, remove the background, or restyle it. Shaders work the same way. Ask the Agent for a shader, like a halftone, bokeh blur, CRT, pencil effect, or describe a specific effect you saw online, like “smudge an image on pointer drag.” It can also tweak a Framer shader that’s already on your canvas. Image and Shader generation work together too. The Agent can generate an image and set it as the input of an image shader, for example one that turns it into a pen drawing with an ink smudge on mouse move.

item.title: Convert Update
item.description: Today, we’re adding Agent support and country-based triggers to Convert . You can now ask the Framer Agent to create, edit, and analyze funnels and A/B tests, or add and edit triggers. You can use country-based triggers to show overlays based on a visitor’s country or region. For example, you can show visitors in Spain a banner promoting an upcoming event taking place in Barcelona.

item.title: Harness 2
item.description: We rebuilt the Framer Agent’s harness to take on whole workflows in a single program. It can read your document, make decisions, and apply changes while the model is still writing the next steps, so you see progress sooner. The new approach uses 2x fewer tool steps and 39% fewer cached input tokens per message, and brings the same capabilities to external agents through MCP. Read the technical blog post for a closer look at Harness 2.

item.title: Localization Update: Content Panel & Opt-In
item.description: The brand-new Content panel makes managing localized content easier than ever. It gives you a clear overview of all your pages, collections and components across locales, and you can decide which ones to include, keep untranslated, or hide entirely. You can also apply these preferences to multiple items, or to all your locales at once. Also, when adding a new locale, you can choose to include all content by default or keep it untranslated. This gives you the flexibility to localize a site gradually, for example starting with just your homepage and including other pages over time.

item.title: CMS Update: Multiplayer Cursors
item.description: We’ve added collaborative editing with multiplayer cursors to formatted text fields in the CMS and on the Canvas, so you can see who’s editing and where. We’ve also refreshed Canvas cursors to make them more compact and with higher contrast. Formatted text now also supports website embeds and Vimeo videos through an updated insert menu. Additionally, in the CMS view, you can filter collections by references and multi-references. Check out the full list of improvements.

item.title: Asset Panel Refresh
item.description: Introducing a refreshed Assets panel. You can now organize your assets in a way that makes sense to you, mixing and matching Components, Colors, Text Styles, Code Overrides, and Vectors in folders instead of working within fixed sections. With new agents support the Framer Agents can now also organize and manage your assets for you to keep your projects tidy.

item.title: Framer MCP
item.description: Introducing the Framer MCP . Connect your favorite AI tools to Framer through the Model Context Protocol. Your agent can work on the canvas, manage CMS content, publish your site, and more. It works wherever your AI tool does, from your desktop to your phone. Connect your AI tool to get started. Be sure to watch the Academy lesson for a full walkthrough. We think you’ll love it.

item.title: Firewall
item.description: Introducing Firewall. Redirect or block visitors based on their country, the path they request, or both. Restrict access to specific pages, or send visitors to a specific locale if your site uses localization. To get started, open Site Settings → Hosting → Firewall, add a rule, and publish your project. Available with the Advanced Hosting add-on and on Enterprise plans. Learn more .

item.title: Skills
item.description: Introducing Skills, a new way to teach the Framer agent how you work. Save instructions for your design system, writing style, or CMS workflow and reuse them across tasks. Reference @pages , @components , and @styles in your project to help the agent follow your design direction, while you keep control of the result on the canvas. To get started, use /skills to ask the agent to create or update a skill. After a conversation where you’ve refined a page or a piece of copy, ask the agent to capture the decisions you want to reuse next time. Skills stay with a project when someone remixes it, so template creators can now include guidance for adding new pages and content with their template while staying true to their design. Learn more about Skills .

item.title: Pinned Projects
item.description: You can now pin projects to the dashboard sidebar, making it easier to access projects you use most without searching your workspace. Right-click to pin a project, then drag and drop your pins into the order you prefer. Pins are stored per account and workspace and are private to you.

item.title: CMS List Field
item.description: You can now better manage repeating content like FAQs, product features, tutorial steps, and cases studies with the new List field in the Framer’s CMS. Rather than duplicating fields like Title 1 , Description 1 , Title 2 , Description 2 , you can group items in a single list and add or reorder rows as you would in a CMS table. Your content editors can spend less time juggling fields and more time keeping your site fresh. To migrate existing content, ask the Framer Agent to convert repeated CMS fields into a List. The Agent will also take care of reconnecting the CMS data on the Canvas. If you have a list that is not shown on the Canvas yet, you can easily add it from the Insert panel. Alternatively, select a card you’ve designed and use the newly added Repeat property to repeat it for each list item. Watch the video to learn more.
